name: Corrupted Windblossom
label: Quest
description: Corrupted Windblossom: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You apply two Cenarion plant salves to the windblossom. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.
